faqs.answer: Our AI uses the latest voice synthesis technology to sound natural and conversational. Most callers cannot tell the difference. We also customize the voice, tone, and personality to match your brand.

faqs.answer: The AI is trained to gracefully handle unknown questions by taking a message, scheduling a callback, or transferring to a human team member based on your preferences.
